product_one_liner.value: Haptiq provides AI-powered enterprise operations and asset-management platforms that unify organizational data, automate workflows, and deliver operational insights for companies, asset managers, institutions, governments, and family offices.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its products and target organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer link to products, services, clients, company information, resources, FAQ, and legal pages, but not pricing.

named_customers.notes: The customer-facing pages include anonymized case studies (a restaurant and hospitality group; a single-family office) but do not identify customer organizations by name.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies New York, New York as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists 2009 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is composed of industry, operations, AI/product thought leadership, company news, and product updates; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The site links to a single FAQ page, but no public product documentation, help center, or developer portal with several articles is linked.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Haptiq job-board search showed no AI, ML, or data-science-titled opening. The surfaced active posting is VP, Enterprise GTM, Orion, not a qualifying AI/ML role.

model_provider.notes: Checked the product page, FAQ, blog, privacy/legal materials, and DPA; no AI model or provider is publicly identified there.

compliance_certs.notes: The product page describes the platform as SOC 2 Type II-audited; Haptiq's DPA names GDPR compliance. No other listed certification was identified.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes Haptiq as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds; no date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile says Haptiq has not raised any rounds, so there is no round in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job-board search surfaced a VP, Enterprise GTM role, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive opening. VP-level sales/GTM roles are excluded by the question's rule.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 28, 2026, Haptiq announced product updates including new Orion connectors and new Olympus Credit modules and compliance capabilities, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found no verifiable dated announcement of a C-level or VP-level departure or appointment in the period. The company does not provide a sufficiently checkable public leadership/team page to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting does not name a CRM or marketing system, and the public FAQ does not identify a systems stack.
